summary: Kraft Heinz Foods Company, guaranteed by The Kraft Heinz Company, filed a 424B5 preliminary prospectus supplement for an offering of senior notes due 20[--] and 20[--]. The notes are senior unsecured obligations ranking equally with existing unsecured debt. Terms are not yet final; interest will be payable annually, optional redemption and change-of-control put provisions are included. The underwriters are BofA Securities, Citigroup, Deutsche Bank, Goldman Sachs. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation event.
